entries.claim: 对于6岁及以上超重或肥胖儿童，应提供或转诊至强化健康行为及生活方式治疗（IHBLT）。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Treatment of Children and Adolescents With Obesity

entries.claim: 对于2至5岁超重或肥胖儿童，可以提供或转诊至IHBLT。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Treatment of Children and Adolescents With Obesity

entries.claim: 最有效的IHBLT项目包括在2至12个月内提供至少26小时面对面、以家庭为基础的多组分治疗。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Treatment of Children and Adolescents With Obesity

entries.claim: 对于12岁及以上肥胖青少年，应提供减肥药物治疗作为IHBLT的辅助手段。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Treatment of Children and Adolescents With Obesity

entries.claim: 对于13岁及以上重度肥胖青少年，应转诊至综合多学科儿科代谢与减重手术中心进行评估。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Treatment of Children and Adolescents With Obesity

entries.claim: 动机访谈（MI）是实施儿童肥胖治疗的核心组成部分，用于与患者及家属沟通改变。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Treatment of Children and Adolescents With Obesity

entries.claim: IHBLT应由初级保健提供者及其团队在儿科肥胖专科医生、联合健康提供者和社区合作伙伴的协作下提供。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Treatment of Children and Adolescents With Obesity

entries.claim: 如果无法获得IHBLT，初级保健提供者应提供尽可能高强度的健康行为及生活方式治疗。
entries.source_doc: Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Treatment of Children and Adolescents With Obesity
